name: aigate
description: Self-hosted AI platform behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint — inference routing across cloud and local providers, MCP tool use, browser automation, image/speech/transcription, object storage, agentic code execution, web search, email and Telegram gateways, and a web UI.

aigate_url.title: aigate URL
aigate_url.description: Base URL of your running aigate gateway, e.g. http://localhost:4000, or wherever it's deployed.

aigate_token.title: aigate token
aigate_token.description: Bearer token sent as Authorization: Bearer <token> on requests — the AIGATE_TOKEN set in aigate's .env (or a per-service override token).
